props.name: children
props.description: The content of the error field. String children are wrapped with Text

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Controls the visibility of the error field (overrides form-item-state context). When used inside TextField, automatically consumes form state

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container

props.name: classNames
props.description: Additional CSS classes for different parts of the component

props.name: styles
props.description: Styles for different parts of the field error

props.name: textProps
props.description: Additional props to pass to the Text component when children is a string

props.name: ...AnimatedViewProps
props.description: All Reanimated Animated.View props are supported

animation.name: entering.value
animation.description: Custom entering animation for field error

animation.name: exiting.value
animation.description: Custom exiting animation for field error
